answer.reason: The verses tell three distinct events of the house's story beyond its completion date, which the summary already gives: the laying of its foundation, the halting of the work, and its dedication.

clauses.english: had its foundation laid amid praise and great shouting
clauses.quote: because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid

clauses.english: was left unbuilt when the work ceased until Darius's second year
clauses.quote: Then ceased the work of the house of God which is at Jerusalem.

clauses.english: was dedicated with joy and offerings of bullocks, rams and lambs
clauses.quote: kept the dedication of this house of God with joy

doubts: Many marked verses (e.g. in Nehemiah, Haggai, Zechariah, Malachi) speak of the house of God in general or of its service and offerings, and were not used as events of the Second Temple itself.
EZR 5:16 attributes the foundation to Sheshbazzar while EZR 3 and ZEC 4:9 attribute it to Zerubbabel and Jeshua; the clause keeps to the laying of the foundation without naming the builder.
